policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV's explicit 'great furnace' supports μεγάλης rather than καιομένης ('burning').
Both passive verbs are naturally rendered by ASV's 'were darkened'; the base reading is retained as fallback.
ASV 'should not hurt' does not distinguish future ἀδικήσουσιν from subjunctive ἀδικήσωσιν; the base reading is retained as fallback.
ASV's explicit possessive 'their foreheads' supports the addition αὐτῶν.
English 'them' does not distinguish masculine/neuter αὐτοῖς from feminine αὐταῖς; the base reading is retained as fallback.
ASV 'should be tormented' does not securely distinguish future βασανισθήσονται from subjunctive βασανισθῶσιν; the base reading is retained as fallback.
ASV's present 'fleeth' directly supports present φεύγει rather than future φεύξεται.
The two readings differ only in Greek word order, and ASV cannot distinguish them; the base order is retained as fallback.
ASV 'crowns like unto gold' directly reflects ὅμοιοι χρυσῷ rather than adjectival χρυσοῖ ('golden').
ASV's construction 'in their tails is their power' directly reflects nominative ἡ ἐξουσία αὐτῶν rather than 'they have power.'
ASV 'They have over them as king' directly reflects finite ἔχουσιν and the base word order rather than participial Ἔχουσαι.
ASV continues with 'and in the Greek tongue,' directly supporting καὶ ἐν rather than ἐν δὲ.
ASV has 'from the horns' without 'four,' supporting the base text without added τεσσάρων.
English 'saying' does not express the participle's grammatical gender, so it cannot distinguish λέγοντα from λέγουσαν; the base reading is retained as fallback.
ASV's single 'for' can scope the coordinated time expressions with or without repeated εἰς τὴν; the base reading is retained as fallback.
ASV 'armies of the horsemen' supports collective ἱππικοῦ ('cavalry') rather than singular ἵππου ('horse').
ASV's 'twice ten thousand times ten thousand' directly reflects compound δισμυριάδες rather than δύο μυριάδες or simple μυριάδες.
ASV instrumental 'by' can render either ἐκ or ἀπό in context; the base reading is retained as fallback.
ASV 'like unto serpents' directly reflects dative ὄφεσιν after ὅμοιαι rather than genitive ὄφεων.
Within the coordinated English negatives, ASV 'neither' does not securely distinguish οὐδέ, οὐ, and οὔτε; the base reading is retained as fallback.
ASV 'should not worship' does not distinguish future προσκυνήσουσιν from subjunctive προσκυνήσωσιν; the base reading is retained as fallback.
English modal 'can' does not mark number and cannot distinguish plural δύνανται from singular δύναται; the base reading is retained as fallback.
In this context both φαρμάκων and φαρμακειῶν can be represented by ASV 'sorceries'; the base reading is retained as fallback.
